Exhaustive enumeration of nonzero tent replicas in L>=4/3 produces the two fibers; their extrema follow from explicit convex quadratics and the phase 0/pi inequality. Sampling is explicitly not a proof.

value.rationale: The stable first-alias regime is a natural spectral phase before the second Zak channel starts to overlap. A full exact low-b condition-number law enables explicit robust lattice design; the lower-bound, upper-bound, and conditioning optimizers are three different rectangular lattices, a motivated structural distinction. The exact 8/5 optimum and square-root crossover are neither the qualitative frame set nor a trivial renormalization.
